The armband is only 0.3 ahead of Salah, so there's no escape hatch here—you are betting on Haaland.

Wood to Watkins nets 6.4 points with no hit. Watkins's projection exceeds Wood's across the horizon, and you have the transfer to spend. This is straightforward.

The main vulnerability is Haaland's fitness. If he fails to play, you lose both the armband premium and a significant scoring asset. If he plays, you're well-placed. Make the Wood transfer and go with it.
